In June, the total value added of industrial enterprises above the designated size increased by 5.3% year on year in real terms (all growth rates of value added are real growth rates after deducting price factors), 0.8 percentage points higher than the previous month.

On a month-on-month basis, the total value added increased by 0.76% in June. From January to June, it increased by 5.4% year on year.
